evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: Distinguishes owned versus rented capability, placing value on sovereign self-origination and control.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Appeals to retaining enduring ownership and sovereign control over one's own perspective against commoditization.

mints.name: SovereignAssetRetention
mints.title: the asset you keep
mints.frame: Does this expression frame independent ownership and retention of capability as inherently superior to rented or commoditized alternatives?
